_readme: Catalog (CDGC) sources, glossary and lineage of the Bid Desk. Sources are CLONED from an existing source of the same type in your org (config idmc.catalog_templates): GET it, strip read-only fields, new name + description + scope, multipart POST with one part 'dataSource' (KB CDGC 02). A link target is '<SCHEMA>.<TABLE>[.<COLUMN>]' in the Snowflake catalog source.

${idmc.project} - Snowflake.description: Bid Desk: the Snowflake tables and views (Bronze / Silver / Gold BID_*: the bid documents, what CLAIRE read, the Data Quality results, the decisions), with data profiling of Silver and Gold.

${idmc.project} - Salesforce.description: Bid Desk: the CRM objects the pipeline starts from: Account (the agencies) and ContentVersion (the bid documents attached to them).

${idmc.project} - Data Lineage.description: Bid Desk lineage: ONLY the IDMC project '${idmc.project}', stitched to the Snowflake and Salesforce sources above.
${idmc.project} - Data Lineage._login_note: the IICS source's three login options (user, its pass option, URL) are filled from these .env keys at --execute, in that order

domain.name: ${idmc.project}
domain.description: The words of the public-sector bid desk, as the solicitations use them, linked to the Snowflake columns that hold them.

terms.name: Agency
terms.definition: The public-sector buyer that issues a solicitation (a county cooperative, a school district).

terms.name: Solicitation
terms.definition: An agency's formal request for bids, identified by its solicitation number.

terms.name: Bid packet
terms.definition: The solicitation document with the invitation, terms, the Bid Proposal Page and the bid form.

terms.name: Signature page
terms.definition: A required form (Exhibit A) the vendor fills in and signs; an unsigned form is rejected.

terms.name: Bid form line
terms.definition: One item the agency buys: item number, description, unit, yearly quantity; the vendor adds price and brand.

terms.name: Item number
terms.definition: The agency's own five-digit number for an item on the bid form.

terms.name: Unit of measure
terms.definition: The unit the agency bids and buys in: EACH, CASE, 5-PK, 2-PK.

terms.name: Quantity needed
terms.definition: The quantity the agency expects to buy over the contract term.

terms.name: Unit price
terms.definition: The vendor's price per unit; the agency counts two decimals only.

terms.name: Brand bid
terms.definition: The brand and product number the vendor offers for a line.

terms.name: Required field
terms.definition: A response field the solicitation requires before the bid can be submitted.

terms.name: Bid readiness decision
terms.definition: What the sales desk must do next for a solicitation: price the bid, fix items, sign or submit the form.

terms.name: Data quality score
terms.definition: The share of rule checks that passed for a solicitation (lines and required fields).
